label: hermes-muse ships one skill, companion, as a directory of markdown: SKILL.md plus 21 reference files, with no skill database and no per-skill record.
The SKILL.md frontmatter is only name, description and version: no tools list, owner, bot list or review state.
The skill body is a router: it names two tools and then points at reference files by topic.
Field types and limits live in one generated interface file, so no other page repeats them.
hermes-muse refuses to own a second memory store: native memory holds what the user said, and the plugin never rewrites SOUL, USER or MEMORY.
Memory intake is a scheduled hourly job over short excerpts, not a chat-time write.
Each message must be classified saved, context or ignored: disposition is a required enum on the job submit payload.
Secrets are excluded by construction because excerpts are redacted before the model sees them.
A model's own guesses or summaries must not be saved as if the user said them.
A full store is compacted by merging or shortening in the same batch; outright deletion is refused.
The compaction rule is enforced in code: a pre_tool_call hook refuses a memory call with more removes than patches.
Staged memory writes are approved from the CLI with /memory approve, /memory reject and /memory pending.
A patch or remove is pinned to the exact entry it matched, so a concurrent cleanup invalidates the approval instead of applying elsewhere.
The memory-upkeep job is hourly and local, and a store at least 90 percent full is named in the packet as memory_full.
All operational state lives in one SQLite file, muse/state-v2.db, as entity rows with an event log kept 30 days.
hermes-muse is MIT licensed, so its skill directory and memory reference are liftable with attribution.

direction: Copying hermes-muse SKILL.md frontmatter as a skill record
reason: Three fields with no scoping cannot express who may use a skill or which bot offers it.

direction: Building a second memory store beside the host's
reason: hermes-muse declines to, because two stores drift and the model cannot tell which is authoritative.
